tools.name: board_overview
tools.description: What this board is: its name, tagline, size, and the forums the current token may see. Start here — every other tool needs a forum slug or a topic id that this returns.

tools.name: list_forums
tools.description: Every forum the current token may read, as a flat list with slugs. Use a slug with list_topics or create_topic.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Topics in one forum, or the most recently active topics across the whole board when no forum is given.

tools.name: read_topic
tools.description: The posts in one topic, oldest first, as plain text. Markdown and BBCode are already rendered down.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: A single post by id, with the topic it belongs to. Useful after search_posts.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search across posts the current token may read. Titles are weighted above bodies, so a topic name finds the topic.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: One member’s public profile: their title, bio, post count and when they were last seen.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Whether this server is signed in, as whom, and whether it may post. Call this when a write fails.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Replies, mentions, quotes and private messages waiting for the signed-in member.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_topic, read_post, search_posts, get_member, list_notifications · Private data: board_overview, list_forums, search_posts, list_notifications · Public sink: read_post, get_member, whoami.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_topic, read_post, search_posts, get_member, list_notifications · Private data: board_overview, list_forums, search_posts, list_notifications · Public sink: read_post, get_member, whoami

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
